title: Sleeping in an Anderson Garden Shelter
hook: Millions slept underground in cold, muddy garden bunkers.

scenes.text: During the Blitz, over two million British families assembled an Anderson shelter in their backyard garden.
scenes.imagePrompt: English backyard garden with an arch-roofed corrugated steel shelter dug into the turf and covered with mounded earth. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: During the Blitz, over two million British families assembled an Anderson shelter in their backyard garden.

scenes.text: Made from six curved corrugated steel sheets bolted together, it was buried three feet deep into the soil and covered with dirt.
scenes.imagePrompt: Cross-section of an earth-covered corrugated steel shelter with heavy wooden blast door and sandbags piled outside. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Made from six curved corrugated steel sheets bolted together, it was buried three feet deep into the soil and covered with dirt.

scenes.text: Inside, it was cramped, damp, and freezing cold. Mud floors often flooded with rainwater after autumn downpours.
scenes.imagePrompt: Interior of dim underground shelter with wooden plank duckboards over shallow puddle, twin wire bunk beds, and a wool blanket. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Inside, it was cramped, damp, and freezing cold. Mud floors often flooded with rainwater after autumn downpours.

scenes.text: Families huddled under wool blankets by the light of a single kerosene hurricane lantern while bomb concussions rattled the walls.
scenes.imagePrompt: Glowing glass paraffin hurricane lamp resting on a small wooden crate beside a thermos flask and a paperback book. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Families huddled under wool blankets by the light of a single kerosene hurricane lantern while bomb concussions rattled the walls.

scenes.text: Despite the damp discomfort, Anderson shelters saved countless lives by deflecting deadly flying shrapnel and falling building masonry.
